## Smart E2E Test Selection

**Selected E2E tags:** ALL

**Selected Performance tags:** @PerformancePreps

**AI Confidence:** 100

### E2E reasoning
<details>
<summary>Expand to read</summary>

The PR introduces a new `getMarginModeLock` capability to the `@metamask/perps-controller` via a yarn patch, and wires it into the Perps UI for cross/isolated margin mode selection in the Pro order form. Key changes:

1. **Controller patch** (`@metamask/perps-controller` 18.0.1): Adds `getMarginModeLock` method to PerpsController, AggregatedPerpsProvider, and HyperLiquidProvider. Also refactors the existing margin mode validation logic (previously threw errors, now returns structured lock state). This is a behavioral change in the perps order flow.

2. **New hook `usePerpsMarginModeLock`**: Calls the new controller method to determine if margin mode is locked due to open positions/orders.

3. **`PerpsMarginModeBottomSheet`**: Now supports actual cross/isolated selection (previously cross was always disabled). New props: `selectedMarginMode`, `isCrossMarginAvailable`, `isMarginModeLocked`, `onMarginModeSelect`.

4. **`usePerpsProOrderForm`**: Integrates margin mode lock state, selection, and passes `marginMode` to order params.

5. **`PerpsProOrderFormPanel`**: Wires cross margin availability flags from feature flags (`selectPerpsCrossMarginEnabledFlag`, `selectPerpsTerminalBackendEnabledFlag`).

6. **`orderParams.ts`**: Adds `marginMode` field to order params builder — this directly affects how orders are placed.

7. **`locales/languages/en.json`**: New string `cross_description_available` (non-cosmetic, affects UI text in the margin mode sheet).

The changes are tightly scoped to Perps functionality. No shared infrastructure, authentication, navigation, or non-Perps controllers are affected. The hard rule seed suggested `ALL` due to the controller package update, but the patch is additive (new method) and the behavioral refactor is isolated to perps margin mode logic. Running `SmokePerps` + its required dependent tags (`SmokeWalletPlatform` for Trending section, `SmokeConfirmations` for on-chain transactions) provides adequate coverage without running the full suite.

The `SmokePerps` tag description explicitly requires: "also select SmokeWalletPlatform (Trending section) and SmokeConfirmations (Add Funds deposits are on-chain transactions)."

</details>

### Performance reasoning
<details>
<summary>Expand to read</summary>

The PR modifies the Perps Pro order form flow significantly — adding margin mode lock queries (async controller calls), new hooks (`usePerpsMarginModeLock`), and additional state management in `usePerpsProOrderForm`. The `getMarginModeLock` call is an async operation that runs when the margin mode sheet is opened, and the `usePerpsMarketData` and `useHasExistingPosition` hooks now do additional filtering. These changes could impact perps market loading and order form responsiveness, making `@PerformancePreps` relevant.

</details>

body: Independent static review found a merge blocker at `usePerpsProOrderForm.ts:885`: Cross eligibility reads `onlyIsolated`/`marginMode` through a symbol-only `usePerpsMarketData({ asset: symbol })` lookup, while the order panel routes through the selected market’s `providerId`. With the same symbol on multiple providers, this can use the wrong market restrictions and either hide Cross or offer it for an isolated-only market. Scope the metadata to the selected provider/market and add a regression test with conflicting same-symbol provider records. Re-review the final HEAD after the fix. Static review run `cfbcd899-77e2-4cdc-b976-d0ca8bf2070a` requested changes; runtime QA remains separate.

Fixed in 9398d2f0e53. `usePerpsMarketData` now takes an optional `providerId` and the Pro order form passes `market.providerId`, so `onlyIsolated`/`marginMode` come from the selected provider's record (untagged single-provider records still match). The same record also feeds `szDecimals`/`maxLeverage`, which now follow the selected provider too.

Regressions with conflicting same-symbol records: `usePerpsMarketData.test.ts` (Lighter listed first, each provider gets its own record) and `usePerpsProOrderForm.test.ts` (Cross offered when only Lighter is isolated-only, kept unavailable when Hyperliquid is). Both fail without the fix.

Also rebased on main. Recipe re-validation was skipped: main's RN 0.86 / Expo 57 bump needs a fresh native build on the QA slot. Still needs the final-HEAD re-review.

Review follow-up at 4991fa272b:

- **Bugbot: position lock ignores provider.** Fixed in 15ab6825f3. `useHasExistingPosition` now takes `providerId` and matches on symbol plus provider, so another provider's BTC position can't lock the picker, whichever order the stream lists them in.
- **Fixture bot.** The update workflow's timings fallback called a moved script and failed (run 36233630953). The job runs one fixed spec and never reads the timings, so those steps are gone. The bot then regenerated the fixture (71df866dd0, adds `KycController.providerFlowStatus`), and `Validate E2E Fixtures` passes.
- **Cross eligibility gaps.** Terminal market data drops HyperLiquid's `noCross`/`strictIsolated` restriction, so Pro keeps Cross off while the Terminal backend flag is on (Core fix: [TAT-4022](https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-4022)). Cross also waits for market data to load or refetch before trusting it (d79110149b, 1894887bcf).
- **Line cap and types.** Provider and gating tests are folded into tables to stay under the 1,000-line cap (999). The `lint:tsc` widening in the panel table is fixed in 4991fa272b.

CI on 4991fa272b: green. `Component view tests (2)` failed once in untouched `BridgeView.view.test.tsx:623` (fiat `$0.00` vs `$1.00`). It passes locally (62/62) and passed on rerun; this PR touches no Bridge code.

Deferred: the position-opened timestamp still matches fills by symbol only (predates this PR, no affected caller).

Not merge-ready. There's no device run for this round because the iOS runtime bridge never answered CDP, so the Cross flow hasn't been re-checked on a device since these changes.


[TAT-4022]: https://consensyssoftware.atlassian.net/browse/TAT-4022?atlOrigin=eyJpIjoiNWRkNTljNzYxNjVmNDY3MDlhMDU5Y2ZhYzA5YTRkZjUiLCJwIjoiZ2l0aHViLWNvbS1KU1cifQ

Device re-check at 4991fa272b (iOS sim, HyperLiquid testnet): the Cross recipe passes 45/45. Cross is selectable in Pro, the margin control reads Cross, and the placed BTC position shows "Position margin used" tagged Cross with Est. Liquidation `--`. The test position was closed afterwards.

The first run failed on purpose: `perpsTerminalBackendEnabled` is on remotely (min 8.3.0), and the TAT-4022 gate keeps Cross disabled while it is, as intended. The recipe now pins Terminal off next to the Cross flag. Until TAT-4022 lands, turning on `perpsCrossMarginEnabled` alone will not show Cross on builds that also have Terminal on.

No new review comments since the last round, so no code change. CI is green; the PR still needs an approving review.
